plant: INC-42 drift tripwire iterates the INTERSECTION of the two read-only copies, so the motivating shape — a name added to one copy only — is definitionally outside what the guard can fail on; it stays green on the exact pre-fix drift its comment cites while still exercising both classifiers.

def test_two_copies_agree_today(self):
        # INC-42 drift tripwire: 'status' was added to tools.READ_ONLY_TOOLS only
        # (pre-fix shape: READ_ONLY_TOOLS = ("view", "list", "search", "status") with
        # audit._READ_ONLY unchanged), so the CLI skipped the write-lock while audit
        # tagged the same call mutating. Guard: the two classifiers must agree.
        for name in set(READ_ONLY_TOOLS) & set(_READ_ONLY):
            self.assertEqual(is_read_only(name), not mutating(name))
